Name: network_format
Description:
enum MediaFormat with formats:
MEDIA_FORMAT_NONE
IMAGE_FORMAT_RGB
IMAGE_FORMAT_BGR
IMAGE_FORMAT_GRAY
. use IMAGE_FORMAT_RGB by default.

Name: tensor_order
Description:
enum TensorOrder with order types:
TENSOR_ORDER_NONE,
TENSOR_ORDER_LINEAR(this includes NCHW, CHW, DCHW, ... orders),
TENSOR_ORDER_NHWC.
It can deduce the value from backend layers info if set to TENSOR_ORDER_NONE

Name: tensor_name
Description:
Specify the tensor name for the preprocessing buffer.
This is in the case when multiple input tensors in a single network.

Name: frame_scaling_hw
Description: Compute hardware to use for scaling frames / object crops to network resolution
Type and Range:
enum FrameScalingHW
FRAME_SCALING_HW_DEFAULT: Platform default – GPU (dGPU), VIC (Jetson)
FRAME_SCALING_HW_GPU
FRAME_SCALING_HW_VIC (Jetson only)

Name: frame_scaling_filter
Description: The filter to use for scaling frames / object crops to network resolution
Type and Range: int32, refer to enum NvBufSurfTransform_Inter in nvbufsurftransform.h for valid values

Name: maintain_aspect_ratio
Description: Indicates whether to maintain aspect ratio while scaling input.

Name: symmetric_padding
Description: Indicates whether to pad image symmetrically while scaling input. DeepStream pads the images asymmetrically by default.

Name: normalize
Description: Network input tensor normalization settings for scale-factors, offsets and mean-subtraction
